section_summary.extract_value: This section details the factor analysis for the male sample of the Indonesian Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). Bartlett's test and KMO indicated adequate common variance. While EGV1 and scree-plot suggested three factors, parallel analysis indicated two factors should be retained. The first factor, General Body Appreciation, was identical to that found in female participants, and the second factor related to adaptive Body Image Investment. The two factors were moderately correlated (r=.34). The attached Table 1 presents the factor loadings for both women and men.
